entities.summary: Robert Bruce Verga is an American former professional basketball player, who played in the American Basketball Association and the National Basketball Association (NBA) from 1967 to 1974. He was a 6 ft 1 in (1.85 m) guard and played college basketball for the Duke Blue Devils. He was a two-time ABA All-Star, in 1968 and 1970.
